subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The military operation was part of a __conspiracy__ against national security.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Plot**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"conspiracy"** refers to a secret plan made by a group of people to do something unlawful or harmful. (षड्यंत्र)

 
 
• **Example:** The authorities uncovered a conspiracy to overthrow the government.
 
 
 
• **"Plot"** is a synonym for conspiracy and means a secret plan or scheme, often with negative or harmful intentions. (साजिश)
 
 
• **Example:** They were arrested for plotting to sabotage the event.
 
 
 
• Thus, the word "plot" correctly conveys the meaning of "conspiracy" in the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Plot**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Enthusiasm** (उत्साह): Intense and eager enjoyment, interest, or approval.

 
 
• **Example:** She showed great enthusiasm for her new project.
 
 
 
• **Motivation** (प्रेरणा): The reason or reasons one has for acting or behaving in a particular way.
 
 
• **Example:** His motivation to succeed drove him to work harder than anyone else.
 
 
 
• **Willfulness** (हठ): The quality of being stubborn or determined to do as one wants.
 
 
• **Example:** His willfulness often got him into trouble with his teachers.
